name: OpenSSL
description: Toolkit for TLS and general-purpose cryptography.
summary: AI tools are allowed. Non-trivial AI-generated parts need an Assisted-by trailer naming the tool and model, plus a CLA version with the AI clauses. You must review, understand and test everything and avoid reproducing copyrighted code.

evidence.quote: declare it in your commit message using an Assisted-by trailer, and
have signed a Contributor License Agreement (CLA) that includes the AI clauses.
Review all AI-generated code before submitting it. Do not submit output you have not read, understood and tested.
Do not submit AI-generated code if you have reason to believe it reproduces third-party copyrighted material.
if a non-trivial portion of a contribution was created using an AI tool, you must declare which agent and model were used.
